kpis.description: Gross revenue generated per unit of advertising spend. 1.0x is break-even on gross revenue.
kpis.aggregation: Ratio of sums over the selected rows. Never the average of row-level or group-level ratios.
kpis.time_window: Rows whose date falls inside [date_from, date_to] inclusive. Default: the whole dataset period (see dataset declared_period). Trends: day / week (ISO, Mon-Sun) / month / quarter.

target.note: No numeric target exists in OPS-001, PRC-001 or the source notes. Targets are never invented.

limitations: Revenue is gross, not margin: ROAS 1.0 is not profit break-even.
Single month (2021-02) of public data: no seasonality, not current.
Ranking is sensitive to outlier days (e.g. youtube_blogger spend 880k on one day).
Spend-weighted: a simple mean of campaign ROAS (1.370) differs from total ROAS (1.402).

kpis.description: Mean days between order date and delivery date over POs with a valid delivery date.
kpis.formula: mean(Delivery_Date - Order_Date) over rows with both dates and Delivery_Date >= Order_Date
kpis.aggregation: Arithmetic mean over valid records in the selected rows (sum / count). Records are not weighted.
kpis.time_window: Rows whose date falls inside [date_from, date_to] inclusive. Default: the whole dataset period (see dataset declared_period). Trends: day / week (ISO, Mon-Sun) / month / quarter.

target.note: No numeric target exists in OPS-001, PRC-001 or the source notes. Targets are never invented.

limitations: 87 POs have no delivery date (68 of them marked Delivered): likely a data gap, excluded not imputed.
1 PO (PO-00101) has delivery before order (-5 days): excluded.
Cancelled/Pending POs also carry delivery dates; the default keeps them (reproduces the published files). A warning states how many are included; filter status=Delivered for a stricter view.
Orders are placed by Order_Date: the last quarter (2024Q1) holds only 2 POs.

kpis.description: Defective units as a share of units, over POs that report a defect count.
kpis.formula: sum(Defective_Units) / sum(Quantity) * 100, over rows where Defective_Units is recorded
kpis.aggregation: Ratio of sums over the selected rows. Never the average of row-level or group-level ratios.
kpis.time_window: Rows whose date falls inside [date_from, date_to] inclusive. Default: the whole dataset period (see dataset declared_period). Trends: day / week (ISO, Mon-Sun) / month / quarter.

target.note: No numeric target exists in OPS-001, PRC-001 or the source notes. Targets are never invented.

limitations: 136 POs (17.5%) have no Defective_Units; they are excluded from numerator AND denominator. Using all quantity as denominator would understate the rate (5.64% vs 6.80%).
Missingness is not random across statuses (102 of 136 are Delivered).
Resolves the open R03 formula question in kpi_column_map.csv: this definition reproduces the published supplier and quarter summary files exactly.

limitations: The score scale is undocumented (observed 0 to 30.89 public, 0 to 29.5 synthetic).

Public file: 200 employee-month keys appear twice with different attributes; department is unstable per employee, and 2024-02 is absent. Differences between departments are small (13.3 to 14.2).
Public and synthetic employee results are separate series and must not be compared: different employer, period (2024 vs 2026) and the synthetic ranges were copied from the public file.
